saints.notes: Basil of Caesarea, also called Saint Basil the Great (330 – 1 or 2 January 379), was an early Christian prelate. He served as Bishop of Caesarea Mazaca in Cappadocia from 370 until his death in 379. He was an influential theologian who supported the Nicene Creed and opposed heresies within the early Christian church such as Arianism and Apollinarianism.

The chemical elements are distinguished from each other by the number of protons that are in their atoms.

About the end of AD 350, he succeeded Maximus as Bishop of Jerusalem, but was exiled on more than one occasion due to the enmity of Acacius of Caesarea, and the policies of various emperors.

It was first used as a punishment by the Achaemenids, Carthaginians, and Romans, among others. Crucifixion has been used in some countries as recently as the 21st century.

saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Ստեփանոսի Հռովմայ հայրապետին, եւ քահանայիցն, եւ սարկաւագացն, եւ ժողովրդոցն
saints.title: Saints Stephen, Bishop of Rome and the priests, deacons and many faithfuls
saints.notes: Stephen or Steven is an English male first name. It is particularly significant to Christians, as it belonged to Saint Stephen (Ancient Greek: Στέφανος, romanized: Stéphanos, lit. 'wreath, crown'), an early disciple and deacon who, according to the Book of Acts, was stoned to death; he is widely regarded as the first martyr (or "protomartyr") of the Christian Church.

saints.name: Saints Akepsimas the Bishop, Joseph the Priest, Ayethalas the Deacon and Plato the Martyr
saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Ակիփսիմեայ եպիսկոպոսին, եւ Յովսեփայ քահանային, Այիթալայ սարկաւագին, եւ Պղատոնի վկային
saints.title: Saints Akepsimas the Bishop, Joseph the Priest, Ayethalas the Deacon and Plato the Martyr
saints.notes: Bishop Akipsimos (Aquiphsimeus), Priest Hovsep (Joseph) and Deacon Ayitala (Ayethalus) have been martyred in the fourth century. Akipsimos was Persian. Together with the Priest Hovsep (Joseph) and the Deacon Ayitala he has been imprisoned during the persecutions against Christians realized by the King Shapouh II.

saints.name: Saints Metrophanes, Alexander and Paul the Confessor, Patriarchs of Constantinople, and Notaries Marcian and Martyrius the Martyrs
saints.name_hy: Սրբոց հայրապետացն՝ Մետրոփանոսի, Աղէքսանդրոսի, եւ Պօղոսի խոստովանողին, եւ նօտարացն՝ Մարկիանոսի, եւ Մարտիրոնի
saints.title: Saints Metrophanes, Alexander and Paul the Confessor, Patriarchs of Constantinople, and Notaries Marcian and Martyrius the Martyrs
saints.notes: Metrophanes (Ancient Greek: Μητροφάνης) is a Greek masculine given name derived from μήτηρ 'mother' + φαίνω, 'appear, shine'.

saints.name: Saints Meletius Bishop of Antioch, Menas of Egypt, and the other Meletius, Bishop of Persia, Buras the Priest and Sennen the Deacon
saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Մելիտոսի Անտիոքայ հայրապետին, եւ Մինասայ Եգիպտացւոյն, եւ միւս Մելիտոսի եպիսկոպոսին, Բուրայ քահանային, եւ Շինու սարկաւագին
saints.title: Saints Meletius Bishop of Antioch, Menas of Egypt, and the other Meletius, Bishop of Persia, Buras the Priest and Sennen the Deacon
saints.notes: Menas of Egypt (also Mina, Minas, Mena, Meena; Greek: Ἅγιος Μηνᾶς; Coptic: ⲁⲃⲃⲁ ⲙⲏⲛⲁ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓⲫⲁⲓⲁⲧ; 285 – c. 309), a martyr and wonder-worker, is one of the most well-known Coptic saints in the East and the West, due to the many miracles that are attributed to his intercession and prayers. Menas was a Coptic soldier in the Roman army martyred because he refused to recant his Christian faith.

saints.name: Saints Demetrios the Martyr and Basil the Priest
saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Դեմետրեայ վկային, եւ Բասիլիսկոսի քահանային
saints.title: Saints Demetrios the Martyr and Basil the Priest
saints.notes: Demetrios (Demetrius) was born in Persia. He has lived during the period of reign of the King Kostandianos the Great.

saints.name: Saints Gurias, Samonas and Habibus (Abibas) the Deacon, Martyrs of Edessa, and Romanus the Monk, Barula the Confessing Child and Hesychius the Soldier
saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Գուրիասայ, Սամոնասայ, եւ Աբիբայ սարկաւագին, Ռոմանոսի միայնակեցին, Մանկանն խոստովանողին, եւ Հիւսիքոսի զինաւորին
saints.title: Saints Gurias, Samonas and Habibus (Abibas) the Deacon, Martyrs of Edessa, and Romanus the Monk, Barula the Confessing Child and Hesychius the Soldier
saints.notes: Samonas (Greek: Σαμῶνας, c. 875 – after 908) was an Arab eunuch, who was captured by the Byzantines and became one of the most influential officials of the Byzantine Empire during the first decade of the 10th century.

saints.name_hy: Տօն Ընծայման սուրբ Աստուածածնի երից ամաց ՚ի տաճարն
saints.title: Presentation of the Holy Mother of God to the Temple

saints.title: Saint Virgins Juliana and Basilla

saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Յակովկայ եւ Իրաւափառայ
saints.title: Saints Jacoc and Themistocles
saints.notes: Themistocles (; Ancient Greek: Θεμιστοκλῆς, Themistoklēs; c. 524 – c. 459 BC) was an Athenian politician and general.

saints.name_hy: Սրբոց հարցն Եգիպտացւոց՝ Պօղոսի, Պօղայ, Մակարայ, Եւագրի,Յովհաննու Գբեցւոյն, Յովհաննու Կարճահասակին, Նեղոսի, Արսենի, Սիսիանու, Դանիէլի, Սրապիոնի, Մակարիոսի, Պիմէնի, եւ այլոց սրբոց հարցն
saints.title: The Holy Fathers of Egypt: Paul the Hermit, Paul the Simple, Macarius the Great, Evagrius Ponticus, John of the Well, John the Dwarf, Nilus of Sinai, Arsenios the Great, Sisoes the Great, Daniel of Scetis, Serapion, Macarius of Alexandria, Poimen and others
saints.notes: Paul the Simple of Egypt (225 – 339) was a hermit and disciple of Anthony the Great. John, the Abbot of Sinai wrote "Paul the Simple was a clear example for us, for he was the rule and type of blessed simplicity." Though contemporaries, he is not to be confused with Paul of Thebes, regarded as the First Hermit. The account of his life is found in Palladius of Helenopolis De Vitis Patrum 8,28 and T

saints.name: Saints Cornelius the Centurion, Simeon, martyred in Jerusalem, Polycarp the Bishop of Smyrna, and the Martyrs that perished in the East
saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Կուռնելիոսի հարիւրապետին, Շմաւոնի՝ ազգականին Քրիստոսի որ խաչեցաւ յԵրուսաղէմ, Պողիկարպոսի հայրապետին Զմիւռնիոյ եւ սրբոց վկայիցն, որք յԱրեւելս կատարեցան
saints.title: Saints Cornelius the Centurion, Simeon, martyred in Jerusalem, Polycarp the Bishop of Smyrna, and the Martyrs that perished in the East
saints.notes: Cornelius (Greek: Κορνήλιος, romanized: Kornḗlios; Latin: Cornēlius [kɔrˈneː.li.ʊs]; fl. 1st century AD) was a Roman centurion who is considered by some Christians to be the first Gentile to convert to the faith, as related in Acts of the Apostles (see Ethiopian eunuch for the competing tradition). The baptism of Cornelius is an important event in the history of the early Christian church.

saints.name: Feast day - Feast of the Conception of the Holy Virgin Mary by Anna
saints.name_hy: Տօն Յղութեան սրբոյ Կուսին Մարիամու ՚ի յԱննայէ
saints.title: Feast day - Feast of the Conception of the Holy Virgin Mary by Anna
saints.notes: Աննայի՝ Սուրբ Աստվածածնով հղիությունը նկարագրված չէ Աստվածաշունչ մատյանում: Այն մեզ է փոխանցվել Եկեղեցու Սրբազան ավանդության շնորհիվ: Սուրբ Կույսի ծնողները` Ս.

saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Եւստռատիոսի, Օքսենտիոսի, Եւգինէոսի, Ովրեստեսի եւ Մարդարիոսի
saints.title: Saints Eustratius, Auxentius, Eugenius, Orestes and Mardarius, the Martyrs of Sebastia
saints.notes: Eustratius or Eustratios, in modern transliteration Efstratios (Greek: Εὐστράτιος/Greek: Ευστράτιος) is a Greek given name. Its diminutive form is Stratos (Greek: Στράτος) or Stratis (Greek: Στρατής or Greek: Στράτης).

saints.name: Saints James of Nisibis, Marouke the Hermit and Mellitus the Bishop
saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Յակոբայ Մծբնայ հայրապետին, Մարուգէի ճգնաւորին, եւ Մելիտոսի եպիսկոպոսին
saints.title: Saints James of Nisibis, Marouke the Hermit and Mellitus the Bishop
saints.notes: Jacob of Nisibis (Syriac: ܝܥܩܘܒ ܢܨܝܒܢܝܐ, Yaʿqôḇ Nṣîḇnāyâ; Greek: Ἅγιος Ἰάκωβος Ἐπίσκοπος Μυγδονίας; Armenian: Յակոբ Մծբնայ Yakob Mtsbnay), also known as Jacob of Mygdonia, Jacob the Great, and James of Nisibis, was a hermit, a grazer and the Bishop of Nisibis until his death. He was lauded as the "Moses of Mesopotamia", and was the spiritual father of the renowned writer and theologian Ephrem the

saints.name: Saint Patriarchs Ignatius the Bishop of Antiosh, Addai the Bishop of Edessa and Maruthas the Bishop of Marv
saints.name_hy: Սրբոց հայրապետացն՝ Իգնատիոսի, Ադդէի, եւ Մարութայի
saints.title: Saint Patriarchs Ignatius the Bishop of Antiosh, Addai the Bishop of Edessa and Maruthas the Bishop of Marv
saints.notes: Armenian Apostolic Church commemoration.

saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Թէոպոմպայ եպիսկոպոսին, եւ Թէովնայ վկային, եւ չորից զինաւորացն՝ Բասոսի, Եւսեբի, Եւտիքի, եւ Բասիլիդեայ
saints.title: Saints Theopemptus the Bishop of Nicomedia and Theonas the Martyr, and the Four Soldiers Bassus, Eusebius, Eutychius and Basilides
saints.notes: Theopompus and martyr St. Theovna have been martyred in the city of Nicomidia in 303, during the period of reign of the king Dioclethianus.

saints.name: Saints virgins Indes and Domna, and Clericus the Priest along with the 20,000 Martyrs of Nicomedia
saints.name_hy: Սրբոց կուսանացն՝ Ինդոսի եւ Դոմնայի, եւ Գղերիկոսի քահանային, եւ երկուց բիւրուցն՝ որք այրեցան յեկեղեցին Նիկոմիդացւոց
saints.title: Saints virgins Indes and Domna, and Clericus the Priest along with the 20,000 Martyrs of Nicomedia

saints.name: Saint Abgar the Witness and the First Christian King
saints.name_hy: Սրբոյն Աբգարու նախավկայ եւ ՚ի Քրիստոստ անդրանիկ հաւատացեալ թագաւորին մերոյ
saints.title: Saint Abgar the Witness and the First Christian King
saints.notes: According to the tradition St. Abgar was the first Christian king of the 1st century, the son of the Parthian king Arshakunie Arsham. He was also called “senior man” as he was the wisest of all and of genius.

saints.name: Saints Abraham and Khoren, Moneyless Physicians Cosmas and Damian
saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Աբրահամու եւ Խորէնայ, եւ անարծաթ բժշկացն՝ Կոզմայի եւ Դամիանոսի
saints.title: Saints Abraham and Khoren, Moneyless Physicians Cosmas and Damian
saints.notes: Abraham (originally Abram) is a patriarch revered in the Abrahamic religions, including Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. saints.title: Saint Theodoron the Martyr

saints.name: Saints David the Prophet-King and James the Apostle
saints.name_hy: Սրբոցն՝ Դաւթի մարգարէին եւ Յակոբայ Տեառնեղբօր առաքելոյն
saints.title: Saints David the Prophet-King and James the Apostle
saints.notes: James, brother of Jesus, is the combining link between the Evangelical saints and the saints mentioned in the Acts of the Apostles. He is one of the important figures of the Initial Church and the first Bishop of Jerusalem.

saints.name: Saint Stephen the Proto-Deacon and the First Martyr
saints.name_hy: Սրբոյն Ստեփանոսի նախասարկաւագին եւ առաջին մարտիրոսին
saints.title: Saint Stephen the Proto-Deacon and the First Martyr
saints.notes: According to the hagiographical sources he was from the royal dynasty of Judas and was the son of law-abiding parents. aStill a young man he was the servant of the chief priest Kayipaya. According to the same sources when the Lord was taken to home, Stephen took off the cloth from his head and spread it under the Lord’s feet thus expressing his true and sincere love.

saints.name: Saints Peter and Paul the Apostles
saints.name_hy: Սրբոց առաքելոցն Պետրոսի եւ Պօղոսի
saints.title: Saints Peter and Paul the Apostles
saints.notes: During the night when Jesus was arrested Peter denied Jesus thrice and later deeply regretted for his deed. After the Pentecost it was Peter that explained to the people assembled what had happened and spoke about Incarnated Jesus. One of the important deeds of Peter was bringing the heathens to the church.
